description.text: Outside a tall stone lighthouse, a storm drives sheets of rain across dark rocks while white surf bursts far below. A keeper in a heavy storm coat and soaked cap leans into the wind, boots slipping on wet stone, and hauls open the thick wooden door. The hinge shrieks, a wedge of warm lamp light falls across the threshold, and the keeper steps through into the round tower base. The door swings shut behind them, cutting the storm to a muffled roar and leaving rain dripping from the coat onto the stone floor.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

Inside the tower, the keeper climbs a narrow iron spiral staircase that coils up the curved wall. One gloved hand grips the cold rail while a lantern swings from the other, throwing moving rings of light over stone and riveted metal. Boots ring on each tread. At a landing, a gust rattles the tower and the lantern sways; the keeper plants a shoulder against the damp wall, steadies the lantern, then continues upward through the dim shaft.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

In the lamp room, glass windows shake under the storm. The keeper sets the lantern on a bench, lifts the brass and glass chimney from the lamp mechanism, and strikes a match. The flame catches the wick with a soft blue edge, steadies into a warm yellow point, and the keeper lowers the chimney back into place. Reflections slide across the polished lens and the metal fittings as the small flame grows.
The camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed.

The lamp blazes up, filling the lamp room with warm gold light. The keeper steps back from the great lens, one hand raised against the glare, and the rotating mechanism begins to turn. A long beam sweeps out through the windows and cuts across the storm, lighting rain and cloud in brief white arcs. The beam passes over the empty stairwell and the rain-streaked glass, then swings back toward the sea. Beyond the windows, the sea heaves in darkness while the tower holds steady above it.
The camera holds a static shot.
